To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch clearance: governance checklist, OKR signal & cross-team gaps

Team —

We have three weeks until soft launch for the Q3 feature set. Per leadership ask, we need a short "go/no-go" clearance and one consolidated OKR signal that we can present at the QBR sync on 8/10. Objective of this thread: collect final gating statuses across GTM, enablement, pricing, docs and support and call out any unresolved blockers.

Please update the attached checklist (launch-governance-checklist-v3.xlsx) and reply with the following by EOD Tues 8/4:
- Top 2 risks you own and mitigation (1–2 lines each)
- Any docs or artifacts required for QBR (links or filenames)
- Whether you need a leadership exception or SLA tweak (yes/no + reason)

Quick notes from me:
- I'm aiming to convert the checklist into a single-slide OKR signal (red/amber/green) for the exec deck.
- If any pricing commitments are outstanding to prospects (e.g., BrightWave), loop in Ben and mark the cell "pricing pending".

Attachments: launch-governance-checklist-v3.xlsx, enablement-train-the-trainer-v1.pptx

Thanks —
Priyom
Priyom Das

Thanks Priyom — see concise status below (I updated the checklist and uploaded the slide). Also attaching a trimmed enablement deck for "train the trainer".

Enablement status (Marissa):
- Readiness: GREEN — core enablement content is complete. Train-the-trainer slides attached.
- Risks:
  1) Field capacity: we have 3 enablement facilitators confirmed; if a second wave of customers signs up the week of launch we may need an extra contractor (~2 days notice). Mitigation: prioritize critical segments for live sessions; self-serve videos pre-recorded.
  2) Certification path clarity: some role mappings still ambiguous for partners. Mitigation: Laura to own partner role mapping doc by 8/5.
- Artifacts for QBR: enablement-train-the-trainer-v1.pptx (attached), enablement-summary-onepager link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/q3/enablement-summary
- Leadership exceptions: NO

Ops/infra gating (Karthik):
- Readiness: AMBER — baseline infra is green but we have two operational gating items.
- Risks:
  1) Region capacity mismatch: EU burst capacity not fully validated under composite traffic profile. Mitigation: we have a small canary reservation for EU on 8/7; need sign-off that EU launch can be limited to seeded customers if issues observed. Action: Grace to confirm which EU accounts are high priority by 8/4.
  2) Observability retention: long-tail tracing retention for the new pipeline exceeds current budgeted storage. Mitigation: apply sampling policy and short-term extended retention (30 days) for 2 weeks post-launch; needs approval from Ben (cost owner).
- Artifacts: support-runbook-extract.txt (attached); deployment runbook updated in repo: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/q3/deploy-runbook
- Leadership exceptions: MAYBE (need short-term retention cost approval)

Quick leadership alignment and OKR note:
- From a launch-readiness OKR perspective we need to present a single recommended signal: G/AMBER/RED. My ask: by 5pm today, each owner should mark the checklist cell with R/A/G and write one-line rationale (e.g., "AMBER — EU canary pending capacity sign-off"). I'll synthesize for the QBR deck.
- A couple of clarifying asks for the team:
  * Pricing: Ben, please confirm whether we will honor the BrightWave IO commitment or if that is contingent on legal signoff. If pricing is pending, flag as AMBER.
  * Docs: Olga, please confirm whether the API migration guide is publish-ready; if not, note the delta and expected publish date.
- If any owner needs a short slot at the 8/10 QBR (5 min), let me know; we have two 5-minute slots reserved for launch signals.

Laura Bennett
VP, Product & GTM | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

- Ben Carter: review short-term retention cost and confirm approval or requested budget delta (due 8/5 noon).
- Olga Petrov: publish API migration guide or provide delta list (due 8/5 close of business).

- Priyom: finalize the slide, circulate to execs, and set the 8/10 prep rehearsal at 8/9 11:00am.

If anyone has last-minute evidence to attach (performance charts, contract notes, DocuSign confirmation), add to the Drive folder and reply-all with the link.

Final note on BrightWave: Alex from BrightWave is awaiting pricing confirmation. Ben please loop in BrightWave Legal if you need DocuSign routing; I've cc'd them on this thread for visibility.
